hero.tagline: I build things for mobile & web.
hero.description: I'm a software developer based in Germany, specializing in building mobile apps, web applications, and full-stack solutions. Currently focused on Flutter, Spring Boot, and crafting great user experiences.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I started my programming journey in 2015, experimenting with C# in Visual Studio — building web browsers, calculators, and login screens. What began as curiosity quickly became a passion that has driven me ever since.
about.p2: Over the years, I've worked with MIT App Inventor, native Android (Java), Unity (C#), and eventually transitioned to full-stack development with Flutter and Spring Boot. I've published apps on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, built a custom programming language, and worked as a freelancer with a perfect 5.0/5 rating.
about.p3: Here are some technologies I've been working with recently:

projects.title: Some Things I've Built
projects.ole_desc: A café loyalty program app where users collect tokens, participate in campaigns, and earn free drinks or discounts. Branches can send campaign notifications to their customers. Published on both app stores.
projects.filayo_desc: A design tool for creating brochures for Turkish supermarkets in Germany. Create flyers, social media posts, stories, and price labels using pre-built templates. Published on the App Store.
projects.instatalk_desc: AI-powered real-time voice translation supporting 180+ languages with text and speech translation. Worked as a developer in the team for several months.

exp.fs_desc: Building full-stack applications with Flutter & Spring Boot. Published apps on both Google Play Store and Apple App Store, including commercial projects for clients.
exp.freelance_desc: Completed 17 freelance orders with a perfect 5.0/5 star rating (14 reviews). Built custom solutions for clients across various industries.
exp.android_desc: Transitioned to native Android development with Java. Published "Text to Speech" app with 1,000+ downloads. Built first game with Unity and C#.
exp.mobile_desc: Developed mobile apps with MIT App Inventor — learning games, company info apps, and more. Published first app to the Google Play Store in 2018.
exp.start_desc: Started programming with C# in Visual Studio — building web browsers, calculators, and login screens. The beginning of a lifelong passion.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.description: I'm currently open to new opportunities and interesting projects. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out — I'll do my best to get back to you!

portfolio.label: // portfolio
portfolio.heading: All Projects
portfolio.subtitle: A collection of projects I've built over the years — from mobile apps to web platforms and games.

p.ole: Café loyalty program: users collect tokens, join campaigns, and earn free drinks or discounts. Branches send campaign notifications.
p.filayo: Design tool for creating brochures for Turkish supermarkets in Germany. Create flyers, posts, stories, and labels with pre-built templates.
p.instatalk: AI-powered real-time voice translation supporting 180+ languages. Worked as a developer in the team for several months.
p.gossip: Interactive historical map showing territorial changes across European countries 1900–1914. Clickable countries with detail info. Bilingual (TR/EN).
p.espor: Sports studio management app: parents track children's attendance and manage payments. Full-stack with Flutter frontend and Spring Boot backend.
p.archive: Document management with user roles and access control. Upload, search, and share documents. Full-stack with REST API backend.
p.yks: Exam preparation app for the Turkish university entrance exam. Offline exercises, solution videos, score calculator, and study widgets.
p.aplang: Custom programming language: write code in three languages (EN/TR/DE), convert to numeric intermediate values, then translate to Java or C#.
p.periodic: Periodic table learning game: correctly place elements within a time limit. Still active on the Google Play Store.
p.tts: Text-to-speech app with 1,000+ downloads. Save as audio, share via WhatsApp and other apps.
p.asteroid: 2D space game: pilot a spaceship, dodge and destroy asteroids. In-game shop for upgrades. Built with Unity.
